findings.message: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is used in .github/workflows/deploy.yml but missing from .env.example.
findings.recommendation: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL= to .env.example and configure the value in your deployment environment.

findings.recommendation: Remove SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY from committed files, rotate the value if it was pushed, and keep only an empty placeholder in .env.example.
